summary: check:visual-coverage counted manifest items of type ui only, so StatTiles and ChartCard shipped with no visual case. The gate now requires a case for every ui and block item, and both blocks have one, in both schemes. StatTiles' case is laid out at widths the sheet draws: below ~290px a tile with a sparkline wraps its label and change line, which is the unbuilt narrow row and now a recorded known gap. Also adds stat-tiles.geometry.json (the tile's uniform 24px inset) to the geometry gate.
